_readme: Per-site branding. Blank values fall back to the theme/platform defaults, so only fill in what this site changes. See THEME-DEVELOPMENT-NOTES.md, 'Per-site branding: app/site.json'.

address._help_showQuickAddress: showQuickAddress: true or false, without quotes. false hides the Quick Address field on checkout's New Address form and the Addresses page. Leave it out and the field shows. It needs a Google Maps key that allows this site's domain.

login._help_createAccountUrl: createAccountUrl: where 'Need an account?' goes. Blank uses the built-in signup page at /admin, which needs the site to give anonymous visitors a temp session; otherwise paste the site's Four51 AutoLogon link.

hero.heading: Gear your team for the season ahead.
hero.subheading: New apparel, drinkware and print kits, priced for your group.

categoryMessages._help: Message bars under a category page's title, keyed by the category's InteropID (not its display name; capitals don't matter). A category that isn't listed shows nothing, and each subcategory needs its own entry - nothing is inherited from the parent. Each category takes a list of messages, which stack in order. message: plain text, required (a blank message is skipped). linkText + linkUrl: optional link at the end of the message - a site page (faq, contactus, order), a full https:// URL (opens in a new tab), or mailto:. style: pick one of three options - "tint" (light wash of the accent colour; the default, also used when left blank), "solid" (full accent colour with white text) or "neutral" (white box with a thin border). Any other value falls back to tint. Keys starting with _ are ignored: to add messages, copy _example_category-interopid, rename it to the real InteropID and fill it in. Reload the page to see a change.

_example_category-interopid.message: Holiday orders must be placed by December 5 to arrive before December 20.
A second message stacks underneath this one.

priceNotes._help: Notes shown on the product page next to the price, e.g. to explain special pricing. Add notes to the notes list. message: plain text, required (a blank message is skipped). placement: pick one of two options - "price" (directly under the price; the default, also used when left blank) or "button" (right above the Add to Cart button). Who sees it: leave out products and categories and the note shows on every product. categories: ["category-interopid"] limits it to products in those categories (each category is matched on its own; list subcategories separately). products: ["PRODUCT-SKU"] limits it to those products, by InteropID or SKU. One note per product - the most specific wins: a products note beats a categories note, which beats an every-product note; ties go to the note listed first. showInOrderSummary: true or false, without quotes - true also shows the note in the cart and checkout order summaries, under the total, whenever it applies to at least one item in the cart (each note once). Leave it out and the note stays on the product page only. The note hides for users who can't see pricing. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Reload the page to see a change.

_example_notes.message: Special pricing: this price reflects your program discount.
Holiday pricing applies to this category.
This product has its own pricing note.

shipping._help_allowedDomesticMethods: allowedDomesticMethods: what a DOMESTIC order may use. Matched on the name Four51 returns, trimmed and case-insensitive, and the whole name must match - `Fedex International` does not match `Fedex International Priority`, so list each variant you want. Leave it empty for no restriction. Methods seen: `Bulk Shipping (over 150 lbs)`, `Fedex International`, `UPS Ground`, `UPS 3 Day Select`, `UPS 2nd Day Air`, `UPS Next Day Air Saver`, `UPS Next Day Air`, `UPS Next Day Air Early A.M.`.
shipping._help_allowedInternationalMethods: allowedInternationalMethods: what an order shipping OUTSIDE domesticCountries may use. The rule is symmetric - an international address sees only these, and a domestic address never sees them, so a carrier listed here is automatically kept out of domestic checkout. Leave it empty and country plays no part at all. A name matching nothing empties the dropdown and logs a warning to the console.
shipping._help_domesticCountries: domesticCountries: country codes treated as domestic, as the address stores them. Everything else counts as international. Empty falls back to US. Canada and Mexico are NOT domestic unless listed here. Note this is country only.
